title: Mobile Edition 📱
excerpt: Mobile Edition is coming soon alongside a major Unfriend History overhaul, improved stability, stronger security systems, performance upgrades, major UI improvements, and support for both Android and iOS.
body:
For almost a year, Friends Remover has helped users manage their Roblox friends from desktop browsers. With features like Unfriend History, background removals, and advanced safety systems, we're now bringing the experience to mobile.

Friends Remover Mobile Edition is currently in beta and is designed to work on both Android and iOS using browsers that support Chrome extensions.

Android
How it works:

1. Open the Google Play Store.
2. Search for Quetta.
3. Install the browser.
4. Open the Chrome Web Store.
5. Search for Friends Remover.
6. Tap Add to Chrome.

iPhone / iPad (iOS)
How it works:

1. Install Onion Browser from the App Store.
2. Open Onion Browser.
3. Visit the Chrome Web Store.
4. Search for Friends Remover.
5. Follow the same installation steps used on Android.

Mobile Edition will continue receiving updates to improve compatibility, performance, and the overall experience across both Android and iOS.

added.moreInfo: Redesigned settings UI for mobile devices.
Swipe left or right to switch between friends.
AFK warning now appears as a toast notification.
Unfriend History entries can now be dismissed.
Logo changes when Unfriend History is open.
Rate-limits sensitive actions and triggers CAPTCHA when needed.

fixed.moreInfo: Fixed history loading only local data instead of server data.
Fixed redirecting back to friends list.
Fixed missing avatars during CAPTCHA sessions.
Fixed inactive friend detection and background removal logic.

improved.moreInfo: Updated history UI to match friends compact view design.
Reduced options to only View Profile.
Background sync now waits for API recovery before applying changes.
CAPTCHA requirements scale based on action size.
Polling speed adapts to friend count.
Avatar quality scales with friend count for performance.
Reduces animations and avatar rendering load.

security.moreInfo: CAPTCHA added to more sensitive actions.
Prevents cancellation when fewer than 7 friends remain.

other.moreInfo: Uses the header search button to search through history.
Settings are fully usable on mobile devices.
Added hamburger menu and sidebar navigation.
Toast notifications now slide up from the bottom.
Friends Remover can now be used on iPhone and iPad through Onion Browser.
